high_level_description: This image captures a serene scene of a road during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the soft, warm hues in the sky. The sky is a gradient of light orange and yellow near the horizon, transitioning into a lighter blue as it extends upward. The road itself is a multi-lane highway with clear white lane markings. On the right side of the road, there is a black and white striped barrier, which is commonly used for safety purposes on highways to prevent vehicles from veering off the road.
